descriptions.text: Enchanted Handcuffs. My safe word is, "Harder, Daddy." You know what these are. Your mom had a pair in her drawer, and your dad was probably no stranger to these things, either. Used to lock a person's arms together at the wrist. This set of novelty handcuffs is magically reinforced. Requires a strength of at least 200 to break. There's no key. These are locked and unlocked magically by you. You may also institute an optional safe word or phrase that disengages.

recap.text: Carl dreads his first Silver Savage Box, which is meant for player killers, and he hopes to avoid a skull. He cringes as it opens and a pair of handcuffs in red, fuzzy velvet pops out. They are magically reinforced and need a strength of at least 200 to break. They have no key, so he locks and unlocks them himself, with an optional safe word. Oh for fuck's sake, says Carl, and puts them away.

Carl slips on a ring, pulls the enchanted handcuffs from his inventory, and has Donut heal the elf hunter, because he wants to talk to him first. Akland wakes cuffed to a pole, Donut behind him with a magic missile ready. He pleads that he is only an accountant who did well at fantasy hunter camp, and they offered him money. Carl tells him about the world he had, and the system tells Carl he has marked Akland.

Carl finds the last of D'Nadia's three guards, an enormous samurai rhinoceros, knocked out for ten minutes by the concussions that splattered the other two. He wants to kill him, holds off, finds the rhino's wrists too thick for the handcuffs, and duct-tapes his wrists and ankles instead. Rend is told not to eat him.

beats.headline: The first savage box
beats.text: Carl's first Silver Savage Box is meant for player killers, and he is not looking forward to whatever this is; he wants to avoid getting a skull if he can. He cringes as it opens. A pair of handcuffs pops out, encased in red, fuzzy velvet. They are magically reinforced and need a strength of at least 200 to break, and there is no key: he locks and unlocks them himself, with an optional safe word. Oh for fuck's sake, says Carl, putting the fuzzy handcuffs away.
beats.gist: Carl's first Silver Savage Box holds fuzzy red velvet handcuffs, and he pockets them in disgust.

beats.headline: Cuffed to a pole
beats.text: The elf hunter is going to wake up in seconds. Hunter Killer, asks Donut? No, says Carl: heal him, but I want to talk to him first. He slips a ring on and pulls the enchanted handcuffs from his inventory. Akland comes round handcuffed to a pole, Donut behind him with a magic missile ready. It's not supposed to be like this, he pleads. He is just an accountant who did well at fantasy hunter camp, and they offered him money. Carl tells him about the world he had. Then the system tells Carl he has marked Akland.
beats.gist: Carl heals the elf hunter Akland, cuffs him to a pole, and tells him about his lost world.

beats.headline: Wrists too thick
beats.text: D'Nadia sent her three guards out as the explosive spiders came. Two are splattered over the wall. The third, an enormous samurai rhinoceros she somehow hired, cast a shield, but the concussions knocked him out for ten minutes. Carl's first instinct is to kill him, but he holds off. He tries to handcuff him, but the rhino's wrists are too thick, so he duct-tapes his wrists and ankles instead and tells Rend to guard him. Don't eat him.
beats.gist: Carl cuffs nothing: the rhino's wrists are too thick, so he duct-tapes him and leaves Rend guarding.

beats.headline: A prisoner for a bounty
beats.text: Mork, a lisping ram cleric of Hellik, jabs a shaking finger at Prepotente: there is a Holy Crusade Bounty on him, and he dares enter this club? Carl raises a hand in peace and points to Prepotente's wrists, shackled in fuzzy handcuffs that are not locked. He has captured him and is here to collect the bounty. Prepotente throws himself to the floor with an exaggerated flourish. The handcuffs jingle ominously, and Carl fears they will fly off his wrists. I have been caught! My goose has been cooked!
beats.gist: Carl presents Prepotente in unlocked fuzzy handcuffs as a captive, and Prepotente flops dramatically to the floor.
